input.name: strip_ycbcr
input.strip: profile_scanner.strip_geometry + sample (4.5-20 m, 128 metric columns over +-1.0 m), uint8, rows INTER_AREA (INTER_LINEAR if <128) resized to 128, far rows first; RIGHT strip flipped left/right (mirror_right)

mapping: logits; type argmax unknown -> no inference this frame (paused like lane_prob_dip); P(dashed) = (dashed + dbl_near)/(1 - unknown) (dbl_near = ego-side line of a double marking -> dashed, dbl_far -> solid); P(yellow) = colour softmax yellow, blue shown white; yellow + dashed passed through (strip_model.StripModel.decide4). LaneStripModel 1 uses this model for both heads; LaneStripModel 2 (hybrid) uses it for the type only and takes the colour from lane_strip.onnx (v3).
